summary: Upvote RSS aggregates content from platforms like Reddit, Hacker News, Lemmy, and Mbin to generate structured RSS feeds. It allows you to track discussions and submissions from these community-driven sites directly within your standard feed reader. The software is released under the MIT licence.
goodFor: It is a suitable choice if you want to follow specific discussions or communities across multiple social link-aggregator platforms via a single feed reader interface.
watchOut: The project currently shows signs of low development activity, which might mean slower bug fixes and delayed support for upstream API changes on the supported platforms.
deployNotes: As a Docker-based PHP application, you will typically need to configure persistent volume storage for any local data and place the container behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
